installation: Fresh virtual environment and empty uv cache; dependencies installed via a package mirror. Python and uv were already installed. PyPI timings may differ.
method: One elapsed-time run per variant and CPU affinity; shared Linux server, no model calls. Installation is timed separately from build. cProfile runs are excluded.
machine_note: The full-server affinity was 0-127; os.cpu_count() and the online CPU list reported 109 CPUs. The 8-CPU runs used exactly affinity 0-7. The server was shared.

public_tests.note: The successful after runs used --lf after resolving two failures, then ran the full suite once the failure cache was clear. The added preparation tests increase the test count. A separate offline pack build overlapped these after-suite reruns on the shared server.
